ready-file.name: The Ready File
ready-file.tagline: Every form filled, checked and ready to print. You book your own appointments.
ready-file.bestFor: You can run your own appointments — you just need the file to be right.

features.title: Route confirmed against your own authorisation.
features.body: We read your visa or approval decision and your entry stamp. EX-18 or EX-17, and the exact date your window closes.

features.title: Your form, generated and print-ready.
features.body: Pre-filled from your verified data, flattened so nothing shifts on print, cross-checked against your passport scan. Second surnames handled correctly. Section 2 — legal representative — left permanently blank, because we are not your representative. The DEHú electronic-notification box left unchecked.

features.title: Modelo 790 Código 012, configured for cash.
features.body: Generated with the barcode the scanner reads, set for payment en efectivo, printed in colour at 100% scale. Plus a named branch near your appointment and its counter hours — not every branch takes tax payments from non-customers.

features.title: Your padrón file, for the right town hall.
features.body: Prepared for the council of the municipality you actually live in, which is not always Barcelona.

features.title: If the flat isn’t in your name.
features.body: We prepare the authorisation form for the owner or main tenant to sign, and tell you exactly what they need to provide alongside it.

features.title: A completeness audit before you go.
features.body: Checked line by line against the official list, including the name-match check that catches middle names present on one document and missing from another.

features.title: A step-by-step booking guide.
features.body: How to book Padrón and TIE/CUE on the official portal yourself: which offices to try, when slots tend to open, what to carry and what you will be asked.

ready-file.delivery: How it reaches you: the whole file as a print-at-home PDF, the moment it’s assembled.

soft-landing.name: The Soft Landing
soft-landing.tagline: The Ready File, plus we hunt your appointment and stay on the line.
soft-landing.bestFor: Most students who landed in the last few weeks and don’t want to fight the booking system alone.

features.title: Appointments, searched and booked.
features.body: Padrón and TIE/CUE, on the official portal, in your own name, across all Barcelona-province offices rather than only the convenient one. You get a dated itinerary: address, time, what to carry, what will be asked.

features.title: A WhatsApp line for 30 days.
features.body: Real answers, in English, through the window where questions actually come up.

features.title: A live line during your appointment.
features.body: If you’re asked something you don’t understand, call us from the counter. You do the talking — we tell you what they want.

features.title: Bank and transit setup guides.
features.body: Step-by-step guides to opening a bank account that actually receives money from home, including an honest check of whether you need a Spanish one at all, and to getting onto the city’s transit system. The T-jove pass itself is an add-on.

page.metaTitle: Packages & pricing: TIE, Padrón and appointments at a fixed fee
page.metaDescription: Two fixed-fee packages for international students in Barcelona: The Ready File and The Soft Landing. One price for the EU route and one for the non-EU route, shown excluding IVA, with optional add-ons, and half your package fee back if no appointment opens in six weeks.
page.title: Fixed fees for a process with no fixed timeline.
page.intro: Every package has a fixed price. Prices are shown excluding IVA: 21 % IVA is added at checkout, and you see the total before you pay.
page.feesNote: Nothing is billed hourly, prices exclude IVA, and no package includes government fees.
page.routesTitle: The EU route is less work, so it costs less.
page.routesBody: No fingerprints, no €16.08 tasa, and where the requirements are met the certificate is normally issued at the appointment itself. Non-EU students need the EX-17, the biometric appointment, and at some offices a separate collection trip. We confirm which route applies to you at triage, before you pay anything.
page.govTitle: The one payment we cannot make for you.
page.honestTitle: The things that cause complaints, said up front.

honest.item: The 790 arrives unpaid, and it has to
honest.note: It’s a barcoded form that must be carried to a bank counter or scanner, paid, and stamped. Online settlement needs a Spanish digital certificate you don’t have yet. We configure it, print it and tell you exactly where to take it — the trip is yours. An unstamped form ends the appointment.

honest.item: Our copies are printed copies, not certified ones
honest.note: We print from the scans you upload. We have never seen your original passport and cannot certify anything. You carry the originals; the folder carries what accompanies them.

honest.item: We cannot make an appointment exist
honest.note: On The Soft Landing we search the official portal for up to six weeks from your submission. September and October are the worst of it — the government systems saturate and slots are gone in minutes. If none opens in that window you get 50% of the package fee back and keep the entire Ready File — forms, 790, audit — so you’re ready the day one does. If a deadline of yours passes first, we give you a dated certificate of every attempt we made; Spanish offices commonly accept that as justification for registering late, though no official is obliged to. On The Ready File you book your own appointments, with our guide. Nobody can shortcut this step legally, and any service that tells you otherwise is selling you something it doesn’t have.

honest.item: We don’t attend the biometric appointment for you
honest.note: It requires you, in person, with originals. We prepare and brief you, and on The Soft Landing we also book it and stay reachable on the phone. The appearance is yours, in your own name.

honest.item: Your 90 days start when you tap
honest.note: The T-jove window runs from first validation, not from purchase. But it’s 90 consecutive days once it starts, not 90 days of use.

honest.item: T-jove is an age rule, not a student rule
honest.note: Under 30 only. No university card or Carnet Jove needed to qualify. If you’re thirty or over, leave this add-on unticked: the right pass is a T-usual for the zones your commute needs, and we can point you to it.

page.exclusionsTitle: What our fee does not cover.

exclusions.note: Paid by you, directly, at a bank. The amount is set by the government and varies by card type.
We never handle funds for third parties. Everything goes directly from you to the landlord or the institution.
Outside our scope. If your case needs it, we will say so and point you to a colegiado abogado.
We identify what needs it and refer you to a traductor jurado; their fee is separate.

page.guaranteeTitle: Half back, and you keep the file.
page.guaranteeBody: On The Soft Landing we search the official portal for up to six weeks from your submission. If nothing opens in that window you get 50% of the package fee back and keep the entire Ready File (forms, the Modelo 790, the audit), so you are ready the day a slot appears. You also get a dated certificate of every attempt we made. Nobody can shortcut this step legally, and any service that says otherwise is selling you something it does not have.

addons.title: Add what you need at checkout.
addons.intro: Tick them at checkout, on top of either package. Each is delivered digitally, so we can set it up remotely before you land. Prices exclude IVA.

t-jove.name: T-jove Transit Pass (90 days)
t-jove.what: We create your T-mobilitat account, verify your ID and load a 90-day unlimited youth pass.
t-jove.delivery: Virtual card loaded into your T-mobilitat mobile wallet, or mailed to your flat.

carnet-jove.name: Carnet Jove Activation
carnet-jove.what: The official Catalan youth card: application, fee payment and digital activation for city and travel discounts.
carnet-jove.delivery: Digital card credential sent by email or to your mobile wallet.

isic.name: ISIC Digital Student ID
isic.what: The International Student Identity Card, issued against your university acceptance or enrolment letter.
isic.delivery: Digital ISIC app code and verification link.

esim.name: Spanish eSIM Setup (+34 number)
esim.what: A local Spanish phone number with 50–100 GB of data, ready before you land.
esim.delivery: Instant QR code delivered by email or WhatsApp.
